Offscreen card images are released after DEFAULT_OFFSCREEN_RELEASE_MS by CardLayer, with timers cleared on delete and destroy.

payload.taskDescription: Build FitToViewButton, Minimap, useCulling, ScaleWarning, texture-cache eviction, and a shared board-capacity guard. Fit calculates bounds with padding. The minimap projects cards and the viewport, supports tap and drag navigation, and collapses on phone. Culling renders only visible cards plus a 200px margin. The texture cache keeps at most 200 resident textures and releases offscreen textures after a short delay. Show a dismissible soft warning at 120 cards, a persistent warning at 150, and a hard stop at 200 with a split-case message. Apply the same 200-card guard to the capture route so a direct URL cannot bypass it. Add unit and component tests with synthetic 150-card data and a guard test at 199 and 200.
